fusions.name: Smouldering Shroud
fusions.desc: Throws a burning shroud over an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It leaves the target [Suppressed], its abilities put out of reach, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Whirled Sash
fusions.desc: Whirls a burning sash that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to set each [Burning] for 5 seconds. [Burning] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sooty Drapes
fusions.desc: Draws a curtain of smoke over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slow Match
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions burns down to its end, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
